predecessors.name: County and Duchy of Luxembourg (House of Luxembourg)
predecessors.text: the lands of the Luxembourg dynasty's duchy, held by Sigismund until 1411

successors.name: Duchy of Burgundy
successors.text: the duchy of Luxembourg, passed to Philip the Good in 1443

ledger.x: 1411: Elisabeth of Görlitz takes the duchy of Luxembourg from her uncle Sigismund.
ledger.cpn: County and Duchy of Luxembourg (House of Luxembourg)

ledger.x: 1443: Philip the Good of Burgundy takes Luxembourg.

1443: the duchy of Luxembourg ceases to be a state of its own and joins the lands of the Dukes of Burgundy (infobox 'Held by the Dukes of Burgundy: 1443'; 'To Habsburg: 1482'); the title survives inside the Burgundian and Habsburg Netherlands.

wars.name: Burgundian takeover of Luxembourg
wars.outcome: Philip the Good broke his earlier agreement with Elisabeth by a night attack and expelled her; 'In 1443, the duchy passed to Duke Philip the Good of Burgundy'.
